newsitem.title: USA: Uranium Resources seen as good stock-report.
newsitem.headline: Uranium Resources seen as good stock-report.

text.p: Uranium Resources, Metricom Inc and four other stocks were considered to be good investments by a fund manager at Lindner Growth interviewed by the weekly financial tabloid, Barron's.
Eric Ryback, whom the tabloid described as the protege of the value investor and mutual-fund pioneer Kurt Lindner, foresaw Uranium Resources earning about $0.44 a share this year and $0.92 in 1997.
"If we go out to '99, you are looking at $2 a share plus," he was quoted as saying.
He said his fund already owns 30 percent of its outstanding stock.

Ryback also said Metricom, a computer communications provider which his fund owned 10 percent, was bound to grow in the near future. The company provides modems that allow computer users to hook up to the Internet without using a telephone.
He also picked Equitable Resources Inc, Questar Corp, Enserch Exploration Inc and CPI Corp.
